title: 第123章 把你刚才的话再说一遍！

content_zh: 要么给钱，要么给命！短短几个字，肃杀气扑面而来，整个鹿鸣湖陡然陷入死寂。“护驾！”唐逸沉喝一声，人却已经条件反射向唐音冲去。唐音就在炎文帝的身侧，离他不过十米的距离。结果，他一转身就傻眼了。炎文帝的身边已经全是人。锦衣卫千户宁川，御前司统领赵虎，掌管锦衣卫二处的苏狂……连站在台下的萧棣，这时候也手持绣春刀，站在了炎文帝的前方。功高莫过于救主，然而，没有他的位置了。好好好，这么玩是吧？欺负我不会轻功呢？“护驾？先护你自己吧！”炎文帝没好气地瞪了唐逸一眼。看来这事之后，是该找个高手好好教教这家伙的武功了。唐逸尴尬得直摸鼻，我本来就没想保护你，我就是想吸引人保护我妹而已，你只是顺带罢了。他拎着绣春刀，走到萧棣身侧。“没猜错，果然来了。”萧棣靠近唐逸，默默给他竖起大拇指。好吧，这家伙的脑袋不错，是比自己聪明。之前唐逸说暗京楼会在今日袭击沈园，那都只是猜测而已。现在果然一切如唐逸所料。唐逸看向石桥上的病恹男子，心头也都有些发毛。娘的，还好早做了准备，否则后果不堪设想啊！整个鹿鸣湖就是个葫芦口地形，现在龙斩将壶口一封，所有人都是瓮中之鳖。“你爹估计也是早知道了，半点不慌啊！”唐逸看了一眼炎文帝，炎文帝脸上很平静，没有丝毫的情绪波动。这么冷静，要么是装的，要么一切尽在掌控中。唐逸觉得后一种的可能性比较大，毕竟京都好歹是炎文帝的地盘。极有可能是炎文帝以身为饵，将暗京楼的全部吸引出来一举歼灭。可问题是暗京楼敢出现，那就证明对方并不怵炎文帝啊我靠！“慌？我就没见这老狐狸真正慌过。”萧棣凑近唐逸，低声道：“如果有一天，你见到这老狐狸发慌了，记住，千万不要相信，他一慌，不是收买人心，就是要杀人了……”唐逸嘴角微抽，大哥，那是你爹，你这么说他合适吗？秦钰和宇文封看着这一幕，脸色都有些难看，他们和唐逸的比试还没结束，诗词比不过，难道还不能在其他领域吊打唐逸吗？结果，被暗京楼搅和了。两人相视一眼，也都没有废话，各自回了使团的位置。现在暗京楼劫持的是大炎皇帝和文武百官，和他们有什么关系？等着看戏就是了。“那……那是胭脂楼的楼主，他竟然是暗京楼的人……”这时，有人认出了站在桥上的病恹的男人，惊呼出声。说话的正是刑部侍郎赵柯，然而话音刚落，赵柯便看到周围投来了无数愤怒的目光，那样子恨不得将他给撕碎了。我们特妈瞎吗？不会自己看，还需要你提醒？胭脂楼是什么地方？那是京都最大的美妆品商会，你老娘你媳妇你女儿都是人家的客人，你不怕陛下误会你和暗京楼有勾结，我们怕啊！刚刚经历唐画那点破事，陛下正在气头上呢，你想死别连累我们好吗！“诸位爱卿，和暗京楼很熟？”果然，炎文帝眯着眼睛看来。“不熟，臣和暗京楼势不两立！”“陛下，臣对大炎忠心耿耿，日月可表，山河可鉴。”“暗京楼此等误国害民之徒，臣等岂会与之为伍。”“……”群臣顿时群情激奋，义正词严，一副要和炎文帝慷慨就义的样子。唐逸嘴角微微抽搐，本来没怎么样，你们这么一说显得你们多心虚啊！这就是大炎的高层？怎么感觉都不太聪明的样子。一边欺负皇帝，又一边害怕皇帝，这是种什么样的心思？“没错，我就是暗京楼在大炎京都分舵的舵主，龙斩。”龙斩咳了两声，抬头看向远处议论纷纷的众人，笑道：“龙斩，单是听这个名字，就应该知道我不是什么好人嘛！”“只是我潜伏京都这么多年，锦衣卫竟然都没有查出我的身份……啧啧，也太饭桶了一点。”听到龙斩这话，宁川和一众锦衣卫高手都脸色难看，怒火中烧。这是将他们锦衣卫的脸按在地上摩擦！然而，他们却无从反驳，锦衣卫有负责京都治安之责，现在让暗京楼猖狂到挟持皇帝和满朝文武的地步，的确是他们失职。“锦衣卫是不如以前了，但也不是你随意羞辱的。”宁川提起手中的刀，指向龙斩：“少废话，有本事，放马过来。”见到宁川这时候还嘚瑟，站在龙斩身侧的孙霸瞬间忍不住了，当即站了出来：“草，都这时候了还狂呢？来，爷爷来会会你！”然而，他刚走出就被孙霸拦住了。“别去送死，你不是他对手。”龙斩盯着宁川，笑着摇头：“没本事，没本事，我一点本事都没有，宁千户可是百晓生高手榜排名第八的高手，敢在你面前跳，我们不是活腻歪了吗？”“等等，稍等下，我们人少，我先叫点人。”说完他从怀中取出半截竹筒，轻轻拉了一下引线，嗖的一声，一道烟火直接窜上空中，随即在空中炸开。唐逸抬头看去，还以为能在空中看到什么图样，结果由于是白天阳光灿烂，看到只有一团白烟正随风消散。但随着烟花爆炸，他便看到龙斩的身后有人突破外围锦衣卫的封锁，向桥边飞掠而来。人数极多，只片刻的功夫，龙斩的身后，便已经站着上百人。所有人都穿着黑衣，戴着狰狞的黑色鬼面，就是武器有点杂，有人持枪，有人持刀，有人拿剑……看着这一幕唐逸下意识舔了舔唇，统一制服，统一鬼面，看上去威严而肃穆。但你这杂七杂八的兵器这就有点坏气氛了，有点九十年代的古惑仔打群架的既视感啊！本来挺正规的，一下子就不正规了好吧！众人见到龙斩身后的人马，顿时都惶恐起来，“好了，我的人到了。”龙斩抬手打了个响指，道：“现在，龙某有本事了。”“宁千户，把你刚才的话，再说一遍！”
content_en: Either give me money or give me my life!With just a few words, a murderous aura hit his face, and the entire Luming Lake suddenly fell into deathly silence."Guard you!" Tang Yi shouted loudly, but he already rushed towards Tang Yin reflexively.Tang Yin was beside Emperor Yanwen, only ten meters away from him.As a result, he was dumbfounded as soon as he turned around.Emperor Yanwen was already surrounded by people.Jinyiwei Qianhu Ningchuan, Zhao Hu, the commander of the imperial department, Su Kuang, who was in charge of the second department of Jinyiwei... Even Xiao Di, who was standing in the audience, was standing in front of Emperor Yanwen with an embroidered spring knife in his hand.There is no one more accomplished than the Savior, but there is no place for Him.Okay, okay, this is how you play, right?Bullying me doesn't mean I can't do it easily?"Protect? Protect yourself first!" Emperor Yanwen glared at Tang Yi angrily.It seems that after this incident, it's time to find a master to teach this guy's martial arts.Tang Yi was so embarrassed that he touched his nose. I didn't want to protect you in the first place. I just wanted to attract people to protect my sister. You just happened to be there.He carried the Xiuchundao and walked to Xiao Di's side."You guessed it right, I'm here as expected." Xiao Di approached Tang Yi and silently gave him a thumbs up.Well, this guy has a good head and is smarter than himself.Tang Yi said before that Anjing Tower would attack Shen Yuan today, but that was just speculation.Now everything is as expected by Tang Yi.Tang Yi looked at the sick man on the stone bridge and felt a little scared in his heart.Damn, it’s a good thing I made preparations in advance, otherwise the consequences would be disastrous!The entire Luming Lake is like a gourd mouth. Now that Long Zhan has sealed the mouth of the gourd, everyone is a turtle in the jar."Your father probably knew this a long time ago, so he didn't panic at all!" Tang Yi glanced at Emperor Yanwen. Emperor Yanwen's face was very calm, without the slightest emotion.Being so calm is either an act or he has everything under control.Tang Yi felt that the latter was more likely. After all, Kyoto was Emperor Yanwen's territory.It was most likely that Emperor Yanwen used his body as bait to attract everyone from Anjing Tower and annihilate them in one fell swoop.But the problem is that if Anjing Tower dares to appear, it proves that the other party is not afraid of Emperor Yanwen. Damn it!"Panic? I've never seen this old fox really panic." Xiao Di approached Tang Yi and whispered: "If one day you see this old fox panic, remember, don't believe it. When he panics, he will either win people's hearts or kill people..." Tang Yi's mouth twitched slightly, brother, that's your father, is it appropriate for you to say that about him?Qin Yu and Yu Wenfeng looked at this scene with ugly expressions on their faces. Their competition with Tang Yi was not over yet. They couldn't compete with poetry. Couldn't they still beat Tang Yi in other fields?As a result, he was disturbed by Anjing Tower.The two of them looked at each other, said nothing, and returned to their respective positions in the mission.What is being held hostage in the Anjing Tower is Emperor Dayan and all the civil and military officials. What does it have to do with them?Just wait and watch the show."That...that's the owner of Rouge Tower. He is actually from Anjing Tower..." At this time, someone recognized the sick man standing on the bridge and exclaimed.It was Zhao Ke, the Minister of Justice, who spoke. However, as soon as he finished speaking, Zhao Ke saw countless angry looks from around him, which made him want to be torn into pieces.Are we so damn blind?I don’t know how to read it myself, do I need you to remind me?Where is Rouge Tower?That is the largest cosmetics trade association in Kyoto. Your mother, daughter-in-law and daughter are all their customers. Are you afraid that His Majesty will misunderstand that you have colluded with An Jinglou? We are afraid!Your Majesty is very angry after what happened to Tang Hua just now. Do you want to stop hurting us?"My dear friends, are you familiar with Anjing Tower?" Sure enough, Emperor Yanwen squinted his eyes."I'm not familiar with you, but I and Anjinglou are at odds with each other!" "Your Majesty, I am loyal to Great Yan, which can be demonstrated by the sun and the moon, and the mountains and rivers." "How can I associate with someone like Anjinglou who harms the country and harms the people." "..." The ministers suddenly became excited and spoke sternly, as if they wanted to die generously with Emperor Yanwen.The corner of Tang Yi's mouth twitched slightly. It was fine at first, but when you say this, you look so guilty!Is this the top management of Dayan?I don't feel very smart.Bullying the emperor and fearing the emperor at the same time, what kind of thinking is this?"That's right, I am the helmsman of Anjing Tower in Great Flame Kyoto, Long Zhan." Long Zhan coughed twice, looked up at the people talking in the distance, and said with a smile: "Long Zhan, just by hearing this name, you should know that I am not a good person."It's just that I've been lurking in Kyoto for so many years, and the Jinyiwei didn't find out my identity... Tsk, that's a bit too much."After hearing Long Zhan's words, Ning Chuan and all the Jinyiwei masters looked ugly and were filled with anger.This is to press their Jin Yiwei's face to the ground and rub it!However, they had no way to refute that the Jinyiwei were responsible for the security of Kyoto, and it was indeed a dereliction of duty for them to allow the Anjing Tower to run rampant to the point of hijacking the emperor and the civil and military forces of the Manchu Dynasty."Jinyiwei is not as good as before, but you are not humiliating him at will." Ning Chuan raised the knife in his hand and pointed it at Long Zhan: "Stop talking nonsense, if you have the ability, come here." Seeing Ning Chuan still snarling at this time, Sun Ba, who was standing beside Long Zhan, couldn't help it and stood up immediately: "Hey, are you still crazy at this time? Come, grandpa will meet you!" However, he was stopped by Sun Ba as soon as he walked out."Don't go and die, you are no match for him." Long Zhan stared at Ning Chuan and shook his head with a smile: "I have no ability, no ability, I have no ability at all. Ning Qianhu is the eighth master on the Bai Xiaosheng master list. If I dare to dance in front of you, we won't do it.Are you tired of living?""Wait, wait a moment, there are few of us, let me call some people first." After saying that, he took out half of the bamboo tube from his arms, gently pulled the lead, and with a whoosh, a firework shot directly into the air and exploded in the air.Tang Yi looked up, expecting to see some pattern in the sky, but because it was sunny during the day, he saw only a cloud of white smoke dissipating in the wind.But as the fireworks exploded, he saw someone behind Long Zhan break through the blockade of the surrounding Jinyi guards and fly toward the bridge.There were so many people, and in just a moment, hundreds of people were already standing behind Long Zhan.Everyone is wearing black clothes and wearing ferocious black ghost faces, but the weapons are a bit mixed, some are holding guns, some are holding knives, some are holding swords... Looking at this scene, Tang Yi subconsciously licked his lips, unified uniforms, unified ghost faces, looking majestic and solemn.But your miscellaneous weapons have created a bit of a bad atmosphere, a bit like the young and Dangerous gang fights of the 1990s!It was quite formal at first, but it suddenly became irregular!Everyone saw the person behind Long Zhan
